Further across the same scene appear cosmic swamp-labyrinths and enduring ideas, historical time and remembrance, then (meta)static pod-deliria and techno-immortalism and shallow seas. The elements remain in this exact order, joined only by direct spatial relations and continuation. Earlier elements remain nearer one another, later elements extend across the same scene, and nothing else is introduced beyond what was dealt.
